description.en: Given n activities with start and finish times, find the maximum number of non-overlapping activities that can be performed by a single person.
description.hi: N activities diye hain start aur finish time ke saath, ek person maximum kitni non-overlapping activities kar sakta hai ye dhundho.

explanation.en: Select activities (1,3), (3,6), (5,7) - they don't overlap. Wait, (3,6) and (5,7) overlap. So select (1,3), (3,6) or (1,3), (5,7). Max is 2... Actually sort by finish: (1,3),(2,5),(3,6),(5,7). Pick (1,3), skip (2,5) since 2<3, pick (3,6) since 3>=3, skip (5,7) since 5<6. Answer: 2. Let me use better example.
explanation.hi: Activities ko finish time se sort karo, phir greedy se select karo

hints.en: Sort by finish time, greedily pick the earliest finishing compatible activity
hints.hi: Finish time se sort karo, greedy se sabse pehle finish hone wali compatible activity lo

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
act = []
for _ in range(n):
    s, f = map(int, input().split())
    act.append((s, f))
# Print max number of non-overlapping activities

approach.en: Sort by finish time. Greedily select activities whose start >= last selected finish.
approach.hi: Finish time se sort karo. Greedy se wo activities select karo jinka start >= last selected ka finish.

code.python:
act.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
cnt, last_f = 1, act[0][1]
for s, f in act[1:]:
    if s >= last_f:
        cnt += 1
        last_f = f
print(cnt)

description.en: Given n items with weights and values, and a knapsack of capacity W, find the maximum total value you can carry. You can take fractions of items. Print the answer rounded to 2 decimal places.
description.hi: N items diye hain weights aur values ke saath, aur W capacity ka knapsack hai. Maximum total value dhundho jo carry kar sakte ho. Items ke fractions le sakte ho. Answer 2 decimal places tak print karo.

explanation.en: Ratios: 6, 5, 4. Take full item 1 (60) + full item 2 (100) + 20/30 of item 3 (80) = 240
explanation.hi: Ratios: 6, 5, 4. Poora item 1 (60) + poora item 2 (100) + 20/30 item 3 (80) = 240

hints.en: Sort by value/weight ratio in descending order, take greedily
hints.hi: Value/weight ratio ke descending order mein sort karo, greedy se lo

starterCode.python:
n, W = map(int, input().split())
items = []
for _ in range(n):
    v, w = map(int, input().split())
    items.append((v, w))
# Print max value (2 decimal places)

approach.en: Sort by value/weight ratio descending. Take items greedily, fractions if needed.
approach.hi: Value/weight ratio ke descending order mein sort karo. Greedy se lo, zaroort ho to fraction.

description.en: Given standard coin denominations [1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 500, 1000], find the minimum number of coins needed to make a given amount. Print the count.
description.hi: Standard coin denominations [1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 500, 1000] diye hain, given amount banane ke liye minimum kitne coins chahiye ye dhundho. Count print karo.

hints.en: Start with the largest denomination, use as many as possible, then move to smaller
hints.hi: Sabse bade denomination se shuru karo, jitne ho sake utne use karo, phir chhote pe jao

starterCode.python:
amount = int(input())
# Print minimum coins needed

approach.en: Greedy: use largest coin first, subtract and count.
approach.hi: Greedy: sabse bada coin pehle use karo, subtract karo aur count karo.

code.python:
coins = [1000, 500, 100, 50, 20, 10, 5, 2, 1]
cnt = 0
for c in coins:
    cnt += amount // c
    amount %= c
print(cnt)

description.en: Given n jobs with deadlines and profits, each job takes 1 unit of time. Schedule jobs to maximize total profit. Each job must be completed before its deadline. Print the number of jobs done and the maximum profit.
description.hi: N jobs diye hain deadlines aur profits ke saath, har job 1 unit time leti hai. Jobs ko schedule karo taaki total profit maximize ho. Har job apne deadline se pehle complete honi chahiye. Kitni jobs hui aur maximum profit print karo.

explanation.en: Job 3 (profit 40, deadline 1) at slot 1, Job 1 (profit 20, deadline 4) at slot 4. Profit = 60
explanation.hi: Job 3 (profit 40, deadline 1) slot 1 pe, Job 1 (profit 20, deadline 4) slot 4 pe. Profit = 60

hints.en: Sort by profit descending. For each job, find the latest available slot before its deadline.
hints.hi: Profit ke descending order mein sort karo. Har job ke liye uske deadline se pehle latest available slot dhundho.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
jobs = []
for _ in range(n):
    id, d, p = map(int, input().split())
    jobs.append((p, d, id))
# Print: jobs_done max_profit

approach.en: Sort by profit descending. For each job, place it in the latest available slot <= deadline.
approach.hi: Profit ke descending order mein sort karo. Har job ko deadline se pehle latest available slot mein daalo.

code.python:
jobs.sort(reverse=True)
max_d = max(d for _,d,_ in jobs)
slot = [False] * (max_d + 1)
cnt, profit = 0, 0
for p, d, _ in jobs:
    for j in range(d, 0, -1):
        if not slot[j]:
            slot[j] = True
            cnt += 1
            profit += p
            break
print(cnt, profit)

description.en: Given arrival and departure times of n trains at a station, find the minimum number of platforms required so that no train waits.
description.hi: N trains ke arrival aur departure times diye hain, minimum kitne platforms chahiye taaki koi train wait na kare.

explanation.en: At time 950-910, trains 1,2,3 overlap needing 3 platforms
explanation.hi: Time 950-910 pe trains 1,2,3 overlap hain, 3 platforms chahiye

hints.en: Sort arrivals and departures separately. Use two pointers to count overlapping trains.
hints.hi: Arrivals aur departures alag alag sort karo. Do pointers se overlapping trains count karo.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
dep = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Print minimum platforms

approach.en: Sort both arrays. Two-pointer: if arrival <= departure, need platform (i++); else free platform (j++).
approach.hi: Dono arrays sort karo. Two-pointer: agar arrival <= departure, platform chahiye (i++); nahi to platform free (j++).

problems.title: Jump Game
problems.titleHi: Jump Game - Kya Last Tak Pahunch Sakte Ho?

description.en: Given an array where each element represents maximum jump length from that position, determine if you can reach the last index starting from index 0. Print 'true' or 'false'.
description.hi: Ek array diya hai jahan har element us position se maximum jump length batata hai. Index 0 se shuru karke kya last index tak pahunch sakte ho? 'true' ya 'false' print karo.

explanation.en: Jump 1 step from 0 to 1, then 3 steps to last index
explanation.hi: Index 0 se 1 step jump karke index 1 pe, phir 3 steps jump karke last index pe
Index 3 pe hamesha fas jaoge (value 0 hai)

hints.en: Track the farthest index you can reach. If current index > farthest, you're stuck.
hints.hi: Sabse door ka index track karo jahan tak pahunch sakte ho. Agar current index > farthest, to fas gaye.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
nums = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Print true or false

approach.en: Greedy: maintain farthest reachable index. At each step, update farthest = max(farthest, i + nums[i]).
approach.hi: Greedy: farthest reachable index maintain karo. Har step pe farthest = max(farthest, i + nums[i]) update karo.

description.en: There are n gas stations on a circular route. You have gas[i] fuel at station i and need cost[i] to travel to next station. Find the starting station index to complete the circuit, or -1 if impossible.
description.hi: Circular route pe n gas stations hain. Station i pe gas[i] fuel milta hai aur next station jaane mein cost[i] lagta hai. Starting station ka index dhundho jahan se poora circuit complete ho sake, ya -1 agar possible nahi hai.

explanation.en: Start at station 3: tank=4-1=3, station 4: 3+5-2=6, station 0: 6+1-3=4, station 1: 4+2-4=2, station 2: 2+3-5=0. Complete!
explanation.hi: Station 3 se shuru: tank=4-1=3, station 4: 3+5-2=6, station 0: 6+1-3=4, station 1: 4+2-4=2, station 2: 2+3-5=0. Complete!

hints.en: If total gas >= total cost, solution exists. Track where running sum is minimum to find start.
hints.hi: Agar total gas >= total cost, to solution hai. Running sum ka minimum track karo start dhundhne ke liye.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
gas = list(map(int, input().split()))
cost = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Print starting index or -1

approach.en: Track total and current tank. If current < 0, reset start to next station.
approach.hi: Total aur current tank track karo. Agar current < 0, start ko next station pe reset karo.

code.python:
total, curr, start = 0, 0, 0
for i in range(n):
    diff = gas[i] - cost[i]
    total += diff; curr += diff
    if curr < 0:
        start = i + 1; curr = 0
print(start if total >= 0 else -1)

description.en: There are n children in a line, each with a rating. Distribute candies such that: (1) each child gets at least 1 candy, (2) children with higher rating than a neighbor get more candies than that neighbor. Find the minimum total candies needed.
description.hi: N bacche ek line mein khade hain, har ek ki rating hai. Candies distribute karo: (1) har bacche ko kam se kam 1 candy mile, (2) jis bacche ki rating neighbor se zyada ho usse neighbor se zyada candies milein. Minimum total candies dhundho.

explanation.en: Candies: [1,2,1]. Equal rating neighbors don't need more candies
explanation.hi: Candies: [1,2,1]. Equal rating wale neighbors ko zyada candy nahi chahiye

hints.en: Two passes: left-to-right (compare with left neighbor), right-to-left (compare with right neighbor). Take max.
hints.hi: Do passes: left-to-right (left neighbor se compare), right-to-left (right neighbor se compare). Max lo.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
r = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Print minimum candies

approach.en: Two-pass greedy: left-to-right ensures right neighbor constraint, right-to-left ensures left neighbor constraint.
approach.hi: Two-pass greedy: left-to-right right neighbor constraint ensure karta hai, right-to-left left neighbor constraint.

description.en: Given a weighted undirected graph with n vertices and m edges, find the weight of the Minimum Spanning Tree using Kruskal's algorithm.
description.hi: N vertices aur m edges wala weighted undirected graph diya hai. Kruskal's algorithm se Minimum Spanning Tree ka weight dhundho.

hints.en: Sort edges by weight. Use Union-Find (DSU) to add edges that don't form a cycle.
hints.hi: Edges ko weight se sort karo. Union-Find (DSU) use karke wo edges add karo jo cycle na banayein.

starterCode.python:
n, m = map(int, input().split())
edges = []
for _ in range(m):
    u, v, w = map(int, input().split())
    edges.append((w, u, v))
# Print MST weight

approach.en: Sort edges by weight. Use Union-Find with path compression and union by rank to greedily add minimum weight edges.
approach.hi: Edges ko weight se sort karo. Union-Find (path compression + union by rank) se greedy minimum weight edges add karo.

code.python:
edges.sort()
parent = list(range(n + 1))
rank_ = [0] * (n + 1)
def find(x):
    while parent[x] != x:
        parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
        x = parent[x]
    return x
mst, cnt = 0, 0
for w, u, v in edges:
    pu, pv = find(u), find(v)
    if pu != pv:
        if rank_[pu] < rank_[pv]: pu, pv = pv, pu
        parent[pv] = pu
        if rank_[pu] == rank_[pv]: rank_[pu] += 1
        mst += w; cnt += 1
        if cnt == n - 1: break
print(mst)

description.en: You have greed factor array for children and size array for cookies. Each child i is content if cookie size >= greed[i]. Each child gets at most 1 cookie, each cookie to at most 1 child. Maximize the number of content children.
description.hi: Bacchon ka greed factor array aur cookies ka size array diya hai. Child i khush hoga agar cookie size >= greed[i]. Har bacche ko zyada se zyada 1 cookie, har cookie zyada se zyada 1 bacche ko. Maximum content children dhundho.

explanation.en: Only child with greed 1 can be satisfied with cookie of size 1
explanation.hi: Sirf greed 1 wale bacche ko size 1 cookie se khush kar sakte hain

explanation.en: Child 1 gets cookie 1, child 2 gets cookie 2. Both satisfied.
explanation.hi: Child 1 ko cookie 1, child 2 ko cookie 2. Dono khush.

hints.en: Sort both arrays. Match smallest greed with smallest sufficient cookie.
hints.hi: Dono arrays sort karo. Sabse kam greed ko sabse chhoti sufficient cookie se match karo.

starterCode.python:
n, m = map(int, input().split())
g = list(map(int, input().split()))
s = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Print max content children

approach.en: Sort both arrays. Two pointers: try to assign smallest sufficient cookie to least greedy child.
approach.hi: Dono arrays sort karo. Two pointers: sabse kam greedy bacche ko sabse chhoti sufficient cookie do.

code.python:
g.sort(); s.sort()
i = j = 0
while i < n and j < m:
    if s[j] >= g[i]: i += 1
    j += 1
print(i)

solution.timeComplexity: O(n log n + m log m)
